representative_official_series_photo.scope: Official 451/453 family photograph; use the data-sheet marking rule rather than the photographed rating to accept 0451008.MRL

individual_marking.authority: 451/453 data sheet page 4 states Brand plus Ampere Rating and shows the family marking layout
individual_marking.inference: F plus 8A is derived from the official series marking rule and the exact 8 A orderable; the official figure itself uses a 7 A example

0451008.MRL.receiving_identity_rule: Body must show F and 8A; manufacturer or authorized-distributor label and paperwork must bind the received material to exact MPN 0451008.MRL and a traceable date/lot

representative_official_series_photo.scope: Official SMBJ family photograph; it is not an SMBJ18A marking reference, so acceptance uses exact data-sheet code LT

individual_marking.polarity_feature: Cathode band required for the unidirectional SMBJ18A
individual_marking.reject_adjacent_code: BT is SMBJ18CA and is not acceptable

SMBJ18A.receiving_identity_rule: Every inspected device must show LT, a legible YMXXX trace code and the cathode band; reel or authorized-distributor paperwork must state exact MPN SMBJ18A and preserve date/lot traceability

official_product_image.scope: Exact manufacturer product image; geometry and color reference only

43045-0213.receiving_identity_rule: Black two-circuit dual-row vertical header geometry must match the official image and sales drawing; tray or authorized-distributor label and paperwork must bind it to exact MPN 43045-0213 and a traceable date/lot

official_product_image.scope: Exact manufacturer product image; geometry reference only

illustrative_exact_mpn_reel_photo.scope: Illustrative only; shows an exact-MPN Molex reel and label layout but cannot qualify the future received lot

43030-0038.receiving_identity_rule: Terminal geometry must match the official image and sales drawing; original reel or authorized-distributor label and paperwork must bind it to exact MPN 43030-0038 and a traceable date/lot

claims: Tape and reel, cut tape and Digi-Reel order options
Product traceability advertised as Date/Lot Code

channel_evidence.selection_rule: Purchase only the exact MPN from the manufacturer or a manufacturer-listed authorized distributor that preserves date/lot traceability on the label, packing slip, invoice or certificate
forbidden: Marketplace or broker stock without manufacturer-authorized chain of custody
Mixed lots delivered without segregation and per-lot traceability

first_lot_receiving_gate.timing: Before any received component is released from quarantine to EVT kitting or assembly
first_lot_receiving_gate.package_inspection: Inspect and photograph 100 percent of shipping packages, reels and trays
first_lot_receiving_gate.body_inspection: Inspect and photograph at least five parts per MPN per date/lot, or all parts when the lot contains fewer than five
required_record_fields: Factory pack versus distributor repack or cut tape
required_photos: Full reel, tray or distributor package
Label close-up showing exact MPN, quantity and date/lot traceability
SMBJ18A LT plus YMXXX marking and cathode-band close-up
Molex header and terminal geometry with the corresponding package label in the same receiving record
first_lot_receiving_gate.cut_tape_or_repack_rule: Accept only when the authorized distributor label or certificate preserves exact MPN and manufacturer date/lot traceability; the factory reel label is not required when an attributable distributor trace record is supplied
reject_conditions: Packaging damage or moisture/contamination that can affect assembly
